archetypes.name: dyn-oos-parser
archetypes.rationale: The change reconciles a reader/writer sentinel format contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the final-summary OOS parser and its direct tests. Focus on whether only current OOS_FILE_MAP rows are counted, malformed rows are ignored, and URL ordering is preserved. Also check that the tests would fail against the previous bare-URL parser. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
